name: Sky Suite
description: Our most romantic accommodation featuring a modern suite with a panoramic deck overlooking the Western Ghats. Watch the sunrise with your morning coffee and stargaze from your private terrace in the evenings.

name: Hillside Suite
description: A spacious suite with a large living area and private garden. Perfect for extended stays with breathtaking farm views and direct access to our walking trails. Ideal for guests who want extra space to relax and unwind.
